$comment: Performance budgets (Part 4.6). PROVISIONAL — derived from spec plus measured headroom on the reference devices we have, with a deliberate safety factor. Not yet validated on iOS Safari, which Part 4.6 names as the binding constraint. See docs/device-matrix.md for what is and is not tested. Enforced programmatically: the build fails on bundle-size violation, and the in-game overlay flags runtime violations against these numbers.

scene.$drawCallNote: Revised 60 -> 90 after measurement, not after a violation. The original 60 was set before bloom existed; UnrealBloomPass alone accounts for ~14 draws across its mip chain. Measured 48 with primitives plus bloom on an Adreno 730. Phase 3 art needs headroom above that, and 90 remains conservative for mobile GPUs. Recorded here because raising a budget you have just exceeded is exactly the failure Part 4.6 warns about — the justification has to be visible, not silent.

load.$comment: R5 separates executable and complete sealed-payload ceilings. JavaScript stays below the original 2 MiB ceiling; the 3 MiB payload ceiling includes the three deterministic runtime GLBs and authored textures. See docs/adr-version41-r5-payload-budget.md.

quality.$comment: Dynamic quality scaling, required by Part 4.6 when the frame-rate floor is missed. Tiers step down on sustained overrun and back up only after a longer sustained recovery, so the game never oscillates visibly between tiers mid-run.
